- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/RegionManagerTest.java`**: added `openTicketsOfTheRegionListHighestPriorityFirstThenOldestFirst`, which uses your example (T-1 to T-5, a closed high ticket, and a ticket from another region) and expects `T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1`.

Nothing is committed.
